provider.name: Hudson River Newcomb to Indian River confluence public paddling access
provider.method: NYSDEC publishes the Town of Newcomb launch, Polaris Bridge parking area and 0.3-mile carry to the hand launch, and Outer Gooley parking area with a 0.1-mile carry to the marked take-out. The stored points are public access/parking anchors; only the Newcomb point is the published launch location. Verify seasonal roads, carries, and the marked landings.

control.coordinateText: NYSDEC Outer Gooley Parking Area coordinate; 0.1-mile carry to the marked Hudson River take-out

provider.name: Hudson Gorge Indian River confluence to North River public paddling access
provider.method: NYSDEC publishes the Old Outer Gooley parking/carry anchor and North River take-out parking area for the Hudson Gorge Wilderness, while American Whitewater publishes the distinct Indian River-to-North River Class III–IV reach and describes the Old Gooley path as the gorge put-in when the release is not being used. Both stored points are carry/parking anchors requiring current field verification.

control.name: Old Outer Gooley Club Hudson Gorge access anchor
aliases: Indian River confluence Hudson Gorge access
control.coordinateText: NYSDEC Outer Gooley Parking Area coordinate; marked carry/path leads to Hudson River access

provider.name: Cedar River Pelon Road to Outer Gooley public-access anchors
provider.method: NYSDEC publishes the Pelon Road River Parking Area and Cedar River access, the Outer Gooley Parking Area and Hudson take-out, seasonal road/gate context, and required exit above the Indian River confluence. American Whitewater publishes preferred Pelon/Benton water entry, Outer Gooley river-side take-out, approximately 4-foot historical stage screen, single mid-route egress, and Cedar/Hudson hazards. Stored points are access/waterline anchors; verify road, carry, landing, parking, seasonal signs, and public-use corridor in field.

provider.name: Indian River Abanakee Dam to Outer Gooley public-access anchors
provider.method: NYSDEC identifies the Rafters Parking Area and Indian River whitewater section, the Outer Gooley Hudson access/carry, seasonal roads, and the mandatory boundary before the Hudson Gorge. American Whitewater publishes the distinct Abanakee Dam-to-Hudson reach, direct Indian River gauge, feature hazards, and route-side take-out context. Stored points are public access/waterline anchors; verify dam exclusion, release instructions, road/gate status, carry, landing, parking, and posted private/outfitter boundaries in field.

provider.name: Maryland Gunpowder Falls Monkton to Phoenix public access anchors
provider.method: Maryland DNR identifies the Gunpowder Falls State Park and NCR trail facilities, including Monkton Station, Sparks Bank Nature Center, and public park access. American Whitewater names the Monkton, Merryman/Corbett, Glencoe, Sparks, and Phoenix sequence and identifies Phoenix as the last take-out before city property. Stored points are access-area anchors; confirm parking, stairs, carry, and water entry on launch day.

control.name: Glencoe Road access
control.coordinateText: American Whitewater names the Glencoe/Home Road access and describes a muddy carry to the river; stored point is an access-area anchor, not a surveyed landing.

control.name: Sparks Road / Sparks Bank Nature Center access
control.coordinateText: Maryland DNR identifies Sparks Bank Nature Center and American Whitewater identifies the Sparks Road river access; verify limited parking, recreation use, carry, and bank condition.
